arxiv-1602-03413.title: On rectifying slant helices in Euclidean 3-space 0 0 footnotetext: This research has been supported by Ahi Evran University: PYO-EGF.4001.15.001
arxiv-1602-03413.creator: Bülent Altunkaya, Ferdağ Kahraman Aksoyak, Levent Kula, Cahit Aytekin
arxiv-1602-03413.description:
A 2016 arXiv research paper by Bülent Altunkaya, Ferdağ Kahraman Aksoyak, Levent Kula, Cahit Aytekin. In this paper, we study the position vector of rectifying slant helices in E 3 E^{3} . First, we have found the general equations of the curvature and the torsion of rectifying slant helices. After that, we have constructed a second order linear differential equation and by solving the equation, we have obtained a family of rectifying slant helices which lie on cones. Key Words:
Rectifying Curve, Curvature, Torsion, Slant Helix, Cone.

arxiv-2103-00983.title: Listening to the city, attentively: A Spatio-Temporal Attention Boosted Autoencoder for the Short-Term Flow Prediction Problem Journal: Information Sciences
arxiv-2103-00983.creator: Stefano Fiorini, Michele Ciavotta, Andrea Maurino
arxiv-2103-00983.description: Abstract In recent years, studying and predicting alternative mobility (e.g., sharing services) patterns in urban environments has become increasingly important as accurate and timely information on current and future vehicle flows can successfully increase the quality and availability of transportation services.

arxiv-2104-05796.title: On the instability of embeddings for recommender systems: the case of Matrix Factorization Conference: The 36th ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing; March 22–26, 2021; Virtual Event, Republic of Korea The 36th ACM/SIGAPP Symposium on Applied Computing (SAC ’21), March 22–26, 2021, Virtual Even
arxiv-2104-05796.creator: Giovanni Gabbolini, Edoardo D’Amico, Cesare Bernardis, Paolo Cremonesi
arxiv-2104-05796.description: Abstract . Most state-of-the-art top-N collaborative recommender systems work by learning embeddings to jointly represent users and items. Learned embeddings are considered to be effective to solve a variety of tasks. Among others, providing and explaining recommendations. In this paper we question the reliability of the embeddings learned by Matrix Factorization (MF).

arxiv-2109-09850.title: Balanced-MixUp for Highly Imbalanced Medical Image Classification
arxiv-2109-09850.creator: Adrian Galdran ,✉ {}^{\textrm{,{\char 0\relax}}}, Gustavo Carneiro, Miguel A. González Ballester
arxiv-2109-09850.description: Abstract Highly imbalanced datasets are ubiquitous in medical image classification problems. In such problems, it is often the case that rare classes associated to less prevalent diseases are severely under-represented in labeled databases, typically resulting in poor performance of machine learning algorithms due to overfitting in the learning process.

arxiv-2111-15513.title: RADU: Ray-Aligned Depth Update Convolutions for ToF Data Denoising
arxiv-2111-15513.creator: Michael Schelling, Pedro Hermosilla, Timo Ropinski
arxiv-2111-15513.description: Abstract Time-of-Flight (ToF) cameras are subject to high levels of noise and distortions due to Multi-Path-Interference (MPI). While recent research showed that 2D neural networks are able to outperform previous traditional State-of-the-Art (SOTA) methods on correcting ToF-Data, little research on learning-based approaches has been done to make direct use of the 3D information present in depth images.

arxiv-2112-08949.title: Slot-VPS: Object-centric Representation Learning for Video Panoptic Segmentation
arxiv-2112-08949.creator: Yi Zhou, Hui Zhang, Hana Lee, Shuyang Sun, Pingjun Li, Yangguang Zhu, ByungIn Yoo, Xiaojuan Qi, Jae-Joon Han
arxiv-2112-08949.description: Abstract Video Panoptic Segmentation (VPS) aims at assigning a class label to each pixel, uniquely segmenting and identifying all object instances consistently across all frames. Classic solutions usually decompose the VPS task into several sub-tasks and utilize multiple surrogates ( e.g . boxes and masks, centers and offsets) to represent objects.

arxiv-2202-10647.title: Efficient numerical algorithm for multi-level ionization of high-atomic-number gases Journal: Journal of Computational Physics
arxiv-2202-10647.creator: Aiqi Cheng, Roman Samulyak
arxiv-2202-10647.description: Abstract An efficient numerical algorithm for the laser driven multi-level ionization of high-atomic-number gases is proposed and implemented in an electromagnetic particle-in-cell code SPACE. The algorithm is based on analytical solutions to the system of differential equations describing ionization evolution.

arxiv-2306-02289.title: Evaluating the Impact of Community Oversight for Managing Mobile Privacy and Security
arxiv-2306-02289.creator: Mamtaj Akter, Madiha Tabassum, Nazmus Sakib Miazi, Leena Alghamdi, Jess Kropczynski, Pamela J. Wisniewski, Heather Lipford
arxiv-2306-02289.description: Abstract Mobile privacy and security can be a collaborative process where individuals seek advice and help from their trusted communities. To support such collective privacy and security management, we developed a mobile app for Community Oversight of Privacy and Security ("CO-oPS") that allows community members to review one another’s apps installed and permissions granted to provide feedback.

arxiv-2312-10065.title: Exploring Social Bias in Downstream Applications of Text-to-Image Foundation Models
arxiv-2312-10065.creator: Adhithya Saravanan, Rafal Kocielnik, Roy Jiang, Pengrui Han, Anima AnandkumarUniversity of Cambridge, California Institute of Technology, Carleton College, Nvidia {aps85@cam.ac.uk, rafalko@caltech.edu}
arxiv-2312-10065.description: Abstract Text-to-image diffusion models have been adopted into key commercial workflows, such as art generation and image editing. Characterising the implicit social biases they exhibit, such as gender and racial stereotypes, is a necessary first step in avoiding discriminatory outcomes.

arxiv-2403-13065.title: Aligned Yet Large Dipoles: a SMEFT Study
arxiv-2403-13065.creator: Quentin Bonnefoy, Jonathan Kley, Di Liu, Alejo N. Rossia, Chang-Yuan Yao
arxiv-2403-13065.description: Abstract We study a non-universal flavor scenario at the level of the Standard Model Effective Field Theory, according to which the matrix of Wilson coefficients c u ​ W c_{uW} of an up-type electroweak quark dipole operator is aligned with the up-type Yukawa coupling.

arxiv-2406-17837.title: Transformer Normalisation Layers and the Independence of Semantic Subspaces
arxiv-2406-17837.creator: Stephen MenaryUniversity of Manchester, UK, Samuel Kaski, André Freitas
arxiv-2406-17837.description: Abstract Recent works have shown that transformers can solve contextual reasoning tasks by internally executing computational graphs called circuits . Circuits often use attention to logically match information from subspaces of the representation, e.g. using position-in-sequence to identify the previous token.

arxiv-2408-04794.title: A regularity condition under which integral operators with operator-valued kernels are trace class
arxiv-2408-04794.creator: John Zweck, Yuri Latushkin, Erika Gallo
arxiv-2408-04794.description: Abstract We study integral operators on the space of square-integrable functions from a compact set, X X , to a separable Hilbert space, 𝖧 {\mathsf{H}} . The kernel of such an operator takes values in the ideal of Hilbert-Schmidt operators on 𝖧 {\mathsf{H}} . We establish regularity conditions on the kernel under which the associated integral operator is trace class.

arxiv-2505-17897.title: T2I-Eval-R1: Reinforcement Learning-Driven Reasoning for Interpretable Text-to-Image Evaluation
arxiv-2505-17897.creator: Zi-Ao Ma, Tian Lan, Rong-Cheng Tu, Shu-Hang Liu, Heyan Huang, Zhijing Wu, Chen Xu, Xian-Ling Mao
arxiv-2505-17897.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Zi-Ao Ma, Tian Lan, Rong-Cheng Tu, Shu-Hang Liu, Heyan Huang, Zhijing Wu, Chen Xu, Xian-Ling Mao. The rapid progress in diffusion-based text-to-image (T2I) generation has created an urgent need for interpretable automatic evaluation methods that can assess the quality of generated images, therefore reducing the human annotation burden.

arxiv-2508-09198.title: ADT4Coupons: An Innovative Framework for Sequential Coupon Distribution in E-commerce
arxiv-2508-09198.creator: Li Kong, Bingzhe Wang, Zhou Chen, Suhan Hu, Yuchao Ma, Qi Qi, Suoyuan Song, Bicheng Jin
arxiv-2508-09198.description: Abstract Coupon distribution is a critical marketing strategy used by online platforms to boost revenue and enhance user engagement. Regrettably, existing coupon distribution strategies fall far short of effectively leveraging the complex sequential interactions between platforms and users. This critical oversight, despite the abundance of e-commerce log data, has precipitated a performance plateau.

arxiv-2512-09340.title: Visual Categorization Across Minds and Models: Cognitive Analysis of Human Labeling and Neuro-Symbolic Integration
arxiv-2512-09340.creator: Chethana Prasad Kabgere, Student, Georgia Institute of Technology, Atlanta, Georgia, USA. ckabgere3@gatech.edu
arxiv-2512-09340.description: Abstract Understanding how humans and AI systems interpret ambiguous visual stimuli offers critical insight into the nature of perception, reasoning, and decision-making. This paper examines image labeling performance across human participants and deep neural networks, focusing on low-resolution, perceptually degraded stimuli.

pmc-11475823.title: Phytosterol Depletion in Soybean Oil Using a Synthetic Silica Adsorbent
pmc-11475823.creator: Birgit Steiner-Zitzenbacher, Joaquín Velasco, Crispulo Gallegos, Maria-Victoria Ruiz-Méndez, Paolo Lucci, Antonio Piga
pmc-11475823.description: Phytosterols in vegetable oils have gained attention for their nutritional benefits in foods and food supplements. However, the use of vegetable oils in emulsions for infant formulas and parenteral nutrition has raised some concerns, as phytosterols may contribute to phytosterolemia in the case of infant formulas and, in a second scenario, to parenteral nutrition-associated liver disease.

pmc-11556074.title: Draft genome of a Pseudovibrio sp. isolated from the skeleton of Pachyseris speciosa from a Singaporean reef
pmc-11556074.creator: Aaron An Rong Loh, Dalong Hu, Jabez Mason Yong Jun Law, Elton Lim Wen Xiong, Lindsey Kane Deignan, Stephen Summers, Joao Paulo Andre Pereyra, Rebecca Josephine Case
pmc-11556074.description: A Pseudovibrio sp. was isolated from the skeleton of the heat resilient coral Pachyseris speciosa. Genome analysis revealed the presence of the complete denitrification pathway and potential dimethylsulfoniopropionate metabolism which enhance coral resilience and production of tropodithietic acid, an antibiotic implicated in host defense. ANNOUNCEMENT Pseudovibrio spp.

pmc-11618693.title: Enhanced dielectric and ferroelectric properties near the morphotropic phase boundary in BNBT-BSN ceramics prepared by the solid-state combustion technique
pmc-11618693.creator: Anupong Luangpangai, Thanwarat Jirattitikarn, Widchaya Somsri, Aurawan Rittidech, Sasipohn Prasertpalichat, Theerachai Bongkarn
pmc-11618693.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The effect of firing temperatures on the phase structure, microstructure, and electrical properties of 0.99Bi0.47Na0.47Ba0.06TiO3-0.01BaSn0.70Nb0.24O3 (abbreviated as BNBT-BSN) lead-free ceramics fabricated by the solid-state combustion technique, with glycine used as the fuel, were investigated. All BNBT-BSN samples were calcined at temperatures ranging from 750 to 850 °C for 1 to 4 h and sintered at temperatures from 1100 to 1200 °C for 2 h. A pure perovskite structure was obtained after calcination at 800 °C for 2 h.

pmc-11658204.title: Non-prescription antibiotic use and its predictors among children in low- and middle-income countries: a systematic review and meta-analysis
pmc-11658204.creator: Segenet Zewdie, Assefa Andargie Kassa, Ashagrachew Tewabe Yayehrad, Mekonnen Melkie Bizuneh, Wondim Ayenew, Melkamu Zewudie, Selomie Mulat, Bayih Endalew Bitew, Serkalem Zewudie, Birhanu Geta Meharie, Tegenu Chanie Tesfaye, Aregash Abebayehu Zerga, Fanos Yeshanew Ayele, Husein Nurahmed Toleha, Birha
pmc-11658204.description: Globally antibiotics are among the most commonly used drugs. Non-prescription use of antibiotics is a major factor for the emergence and spread of antimicrobial resistance one of the top global public health and development threats. This systematic review and meta-analysis aim to assess non-prescription antibiotic use and predictors among children in Low and middle-income countries.

pmc-12470830.title: Inflammatory Indices vs. CA 125 for the Diagnosis of Early Ovarian Cancer: Evidence from a Multicenter Prospective Italian Cohort
pmc-12470830.creator: Carlo Ronsini, Stefano Restaino, Manuela Ludovisi, Giuseppe Vizzielli, Mariano Catello Di Donna, Giuseppe Cucinella, Maria Cristina Solazzo, Cono Scaffa, Pasquale De Franciscis, Mario Fordellone, Stefano Cianci, Vito Chiantera
pmc-12470830.description: Simple SummaryOvarian cancer (OC) diagnosis remains challenging due to the low specificity of CA 125, requiring additional biomarkers for improved accuracy. This prospective multicenter study analyzed 94 patients with adnexal masses, including 31 benign tumors, 42 borderline ovarian tumors (BOTs), and 21 OC cases.

pmc-12709769.title: Impact of a 25-minute nap on cognitive variables and reactive management of disruptive behaviour in trainee secondary school physical education teachers
pmc-12709769.creator: Talel Maddeh, Inès Souid, Hamdi Snoussi, Raouf Hammami, Mert Kurnaz, Mustafa Altınkök
pmc-12709769.description: AbstractSleep deprivation in trainee teachers (TTs) increases the risk of cognitive disorders specific to teaching. The aim of this study was to examine the effects of a 25-minute nap on certain cognitive faculties in these teachers, with a view to creating a learning climate more conducive to the transfer of knowledge. Sixty male TT (21.77 ± 0.

pmc-13025709.title: Head and Neck Kaposi Sarcoma—An Updated Focus on Clinical and Epidemiological Characteristics: A Comprehensive Review
pmc-13025709.creator: Luis Alberto Gaitán-Cepeda, Brenda Daniela Ortega-Hidalgo, César Esquivel-Chirinos, Iñigo Gaitán-Salvatella, Stephany Paladines-Calle, Daniela Carmona-Ruíz
pmc-13025709.description: Background/Objectives: Interest in Oral Kaposi’s sarcoma (OKS) has declined recently, potentially causing diagnostic errors due to physicians’ unfamiliarity with its presentation. This review describes clinical and demographic characteristics of OKS patients across epidemiological groups. Methods: A literature search of studies published from 1957 to December 2024 was conducted using PubMed, Web of Science, Cochrane Library, Scopus, and Google Scholar.

pmc-13062410.title: Arthroscopic Management of a Bucket-Handle Acetabular Labral Tear in a Pediatric Patient: A Rare Case Report with Associated Fleck Sign
pmc-13062410.creator: Mattia Blancato, Pierre Laboudie
pmc-13062410.description: Introduction:Bucket-handle tears of the acetabular labrum are rare injuries, especially in pediatric patients. Typically resulting from high-energy trauma, they are often challenging to diagnose due to subtle clinical signs and non-specific imaging findings.Case Report:We report the case of a pediatric patient presenting with progressive hip pain and functional limitation after trauma.

pmc-13279557.title: Discordance Between 16S rRNA Similarity and Genome‐Based Species Boundaries in Gluconobacter
pmc-13279557.creator: Shintaro Maeno, Naoya Kataoka, Minenosuke Matsutani, Toshiharu Yakushi
pmc-13279557.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). The 16S rRNA gene is widely used for bacterial identification, but its resolving power is limited in several taxa. In the genus Gluconobacter, species boundaries remain unclear despite reliance on 16S‐based classification. To examine these limitations, we analyzed all publicly available complete genomes (n = 12) together with curated 16S rRNA sequences and compared 16S rRNA sequences similarity with genome‐based relatedness. Within the sampled complete genomes, 16S rRNA sequences were highly conserved and showed substantial overlap between intra‐ and interspecific similarities.

pmc-13415391.title: Machine Learning-Driven Advances in Perovskite Materials and Solar Cells
pmc-13415391.creator: Jun Ren, Xiangshun Geng, Shangjian Liu, Qinghua Liu, Shuoying Li, Tian-Ling Ren
pmc-13415391.description: Driven by advances in renewable energy technologies, research on perovskite optoelectronics has advanced rapidly across material exploration, device engineering, and intelligent integrated systems. Conventional trial-and-error experiments face inherent constraints in precisely regulating perovskite chemical compositions and microstructures, as well as in mitigating degradation in perovskite solar cells (PSCs).
